description: This file contains utility functions for image preprocessing and decoding ImageNet predictions, including a function to preprocess input tensors and a function to decode prediction tensors into human-readable class labels with confidence scores.

methods.name: preprocess_input
methods.description: Preprocesses a tensor encoding a batch of images by converting RGB to BGR and zero-centering by mean pixel values.

methods.name: decode_predictions
methods.description: Decodes a batch of prediction tensors into top class labels with descriptions and scores, initializing class index mapping if necessary.
